---
title: "Installation & Setup"
subtitle: "Environment Setup for the AI Arabic Speech Rehabilitation Platform"
---

## Requirements

::: {.callout-note}
A **CUDA-capable GPU** is strongly recommended for real-time inference. All modules fall back gracefully to CPU, but response times will increase significantly.
:::

| Requirement | Version |
|---|---|
| Python | 3.10+ |
| CUDA Toolkit | 11.8+ (optional, for GPU) |
| Conda | Latest |
| Git | Latest |
| FFmpeg | Latest |
| RAM | 8 GB minimum, 16 GB recommended |
| VRAM | 4 GB+ (for Whisper + MediaPipe concurrent) |

---

## Step 1 — Create the Conda Environment

```bash
conda create --name speech_therapy python=3.10 -y
conda activate speech_therapy
```

---

## Step 2 — Install FFmpeg

FFmpeg is required by Whisper for audio decoding.

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Windows (Conda)
```bash
conda install -c conda-forge ffmpeg -y
```

### Linux / WSL
```bash
sudo apt update && sudo apt install ffmpeg -y
```

### macOS
```bash
brew install ffmpeg
```

:::

---

## Step 3 — Install Python Dependencies

```bash
pip install torch torchvision torchaudio --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu118
pip install openai-whisper
pip install mediapipe
pip install opencv-python
pip install gradio
pip install transformers accelerate
pip install soundfile
pip install numpy
```

::: {.callout-tip}
## CPU-Only Installation
If you do not have a GPU, replace the PyTorch install command with:
```bash
pip install torch torchvision torchaudio
```
:::

---

## Step 4 — Install Habibi-TTS

The TTS module uses **Habibi-TTS**, a dialect-aware Arabic speech synthesis engine.

```bash
# Clone the Habibi-TTS repository inside the project folder
git clone https://github.com/Habibi-TTS/Habibi-TTS-main

# Install its dependencies
cd Habibi-TTS-main
pip install -r requirements.txt
cd ..
```

---

## Step 5 — Download AI Models

Each model must be downloaded separately. Run the download scripts from the project root:

```bash
# Download OpenAI Whisper (base model — Arabic optimized)
python whisper_download.py

# Download Qwen Text Generation Model (for Story Generator)
python qwen_model_download.py

# Download Qwen3-ASR Model (for Advanced STT)
python Download_the_TextGeneration_Model.py

# Download additional assets (fonts, etc.)
python download_assets.py
```

::: {.callout-warning}
## Disk Space
Model downloads require approximately **5–10 GB** of disk space total.  
Ensure your drive has sufficient free space before running download scripts.
:::

---

## Step 6 — Download MediaPipe Face Landmarker

The Lip Vision module requires the MediaPipe face landmark task file.

```bash
python Amiri_font_download.py
```

Or download manually:
```bash
wget -O face_landmarker.task https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/face_landmarker/face_landmarker/float16/1/face_landmarker.task
```

---

## Step 7 — Verify the Environment

Run this quick check to confirm all key dependencies are loaded:

```python
import torch
import whisper
import mediapipe
import cv2
import gradio
import transformers

print(f"PyTorch:      {torch.__version__}")
print(f"CUDA:         {torch.cuda.is_available()}")
print(f"OpenCV:       {cv2.__version__}")
print(f"Gradio:       {gradio.__version__}")
print(f"Transformers: {transformers.__version__}")
print("All dependencies OK!")
```

## Project Folder Structure

After setup, your project directory should look like this:

```
Communication Disorders/
├── lips_prototype.py          # Saif — Lip Apraxia Vision
├── speech_prototype.py        # Layla — Whisper STT
├── tts_prototype.py           # Habibi TTS
├── multimodal_prototype.py    # Combined Multimodal System
├── Story_Generator.py         # Arabic Story Generator
├── merged_prototype.py        # Merged Story + Vision
├── Qwen3-ASR.py               # Advanced Qwen ASR
├── face_landmarker.task       # MediaPipe model asset
├── whisper_models/            # Downloaded Whisper weights
├── qwen_model/                # Qwen3-ASR model weights
├── qwen_text_model/           # Qwen text model weights
├── kokoro_cached_model/       # Cached TTS model
├── Habibi-TTS-main/           # TTS engine source
├── fonts/                     # Amiri Arabic font
├── games/
│   ├── Maze Craze v1/
│   └── Maze Craze v2/
├── whisper_download.py
├── qwen_model_download.py
├── download_assets.py
└── py_env.md
```

---

## Running Each Module

| Module | Command |
|---|---|
| Lip Apraxia Vision (Saif) | `python lips_prototype.py` |
| Speech-to-Text (Layla) | `python speech_prototype.py` |
| Arabic TTS | `python tts_prototype.py` |
| Multimodal System | `python multimodal_prototype.py` |
| Story Generator | `python Story_Generator.py` |
| Advanced ASR (Qwen3) | `python Qwen3-ASR.py` |
| Maze Game | Open `games/Maze Craze v2/index.html` in browser |
